Shabbir Tera Sajda Sajdon Ki Inteha Hai
Khoon-e-Hussain Say Hee  Buniyad Laillah Hai

1
Kaye Baar Teer Uskay Hatho Say Ghirta Dekha
Khata Hai Khauf Dekho  Asghar Say Hurmala Hai

2
Ghurbat Ki Sada Ran Main Daitay Hay Shah Baikas
Akbar Raha Na Asghar  Aur Na Hee Bawafa Hai

3
Khud Apne Laal Pehjay Agoosh Main Ajaal Ki
Kitna Azeem Karbal  Maa’ou Ka Honsla Hai

4
Abbas Tera Sar Nay Dekha Hai Kaisay Manzaar
Ik Naizay Saar Buland Hai  Ik Naizay Pay Rida Hai

5
Dastar-e-Istarha Say Akbar Ko Shah Nay Bandhi
Sab Bibiyon Nay Khaimay  Inna Illah Para Hai

6
Teri Laash Ko Main Qasim Dhondo Kaha Kaha Paar
Tanha Hussain Ran Main  Daitay Rahi Sada Hai

7
Bhayi Ka Pyaar Dekha Jag Say Anokha Shahid
Honto Pay Naam Zainab  Khanjar Talay Gala Hai

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/shabbir-tera-sajda-sajdon-ki-inteha-hai.md')
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:' + str(p)], text=True).split('---', 2)[2].strip()
_, metadata, source = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line[2:] for line in metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1].splitlines()).strip()
assert old.casefold() == roman.casefold()
groups = [part.splitlines() for part in source.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert [len(group) for group in groups] == [2] + [3] * 7
assert [group[0] for group in groups[1:]] == list('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷')
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
assert '\\u200c' not in source
print('Verified 16 paired verses, seven stanza numbers, and preserved Roman wording.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script, including the two-line opening and seven numbered stanzas. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`, adjusted its capitalization, added the Urdu title, set right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read “Dastar-e-Istarha” as “دستار اس طرح” and “Inna Illah” as “اِنّا لِلّٰہ”.
